$comment: Live E2E target configuration. Copy to tests/targets.json and fill in.
tests/targets.json is gitignored — never commit real IDs.
EVERY id listed under `disposable` is treated as expendable: the suite
will send to it, edit it, delete messages in it, wipe its history, and
(tier 5 only) disperse it. Nothing outside this list is ever written to.
`denylist` is a hard stop: if an id ever appears in both lists, or a
destructive helper is handed a denylisted id, the suite throws before
`home` is the THROWAWAY config dir the suite drives — it becomes
USERPROFILE/HOME for every CLI subprocess, so it decides which
~/.zalo-agent-cli the destructive tiers act on. It is validated: a
missing key, a path that does not exist, or your real home directory
each refuse the run. Log in once against it with
USERPROFILE=<that dir> HOME=<that dir> node src/index.js login
notes: memberIds must NOT include your own ownId — `group create` adds you as owner.
If the tier-5 disperse test runs, the group is recreated from `name` +
`memberIds`, so keep both accurate. The recreated group gets a NEW
threadId, which the suite writes back into this file.
